song_craft: Prayer-grounds song (17v): grounds-past (v1) -> hoard-yet-joins-not, her-dangling (v2) -> frame-or-what (v3) -> pain-thieving faring (v4) -> creeper-decked (v5) -> face-orb drowning (v6) -> glad-shape gaps (v7) -> unexcelled soon (v8) -> clashes-rush (v9) -> rays-licked (v10) -> strand-thieves (v11) -> piths-brimmed (v12) -> freedom-love-whence (v13) -> speck-starved wings (v14) -> slave-clear (v15) -> honey-oozing (v16) -> Master-father-mother (v17). Revealed meaning.

lines: Prayer-grounds-past, strange-fruit-giving —
wins, unheard-storied Śiva, true-wish-tree.

lines: In all things, from one hoard, through self —
from Thee all, they say, is won. Yet this self of mine joins Thee not, Highest — her, never.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvavastuni ca yaikanidhānāt svātmanas tvad akhilaṃ kila labhyam asya me punar asau nijā ātmā na tvam eva ghaṭase paramās tām
notes: tām (her) dangles in SA without a noun; kept dangling

verses.craft: Hoard-won yet joins-not (Highest-her-never); tAm dangling kept per note; nijA feminine + paramAs open (Her conjectural per UNC).
verses.rejected: (a) filling Her noun killed dangling. (b) resolving segmentation killed open.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["nijā (fem.) + tām (her) figure the self as feminine before the Lord; paramās segmentation is open (supreme ones? be supreme?); L2's 'Her' is conjectural — needs Kṣemarāja Vivṛti."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice

lines: Knowing-doing-made knowing-frame, the self — in all ways High Lord alone may it be.
A frame amid all these things — forsooth, be it not? What else then?
l4.sanskrit_cite: jñānakarmamayacidvapur ātmā sarvathaiṣa parameśvara eva syād vapus tu nikhileṣu padārtheṣv eṣu nāma na bhavet kim utānyat

verses.rejected: (a) frame->body kept: frames. (b) forsooth->indeed kept: forsooths.

lines: By matchless pain-thieving fruit, by Thy-glance-natured —
melted, by the road, Lord — be mine Thy-made faring.

when, ripening, perfect-folks'-minds'-wonder-birthing, befall me from Thee?

shall I full-behold, which streams nectar-flood unheard, drowning the world whole?

when, Lord, with high-nectar-floods fill my far gaps, named Thy-undifference-freedom, ever?

lines: By Thine unexcelled-sap-touch, restlessness dropped —
not yet today my mind, Lord. When be it? Be it soon.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvadīyānuttararasāsaṅgasaṃtyaktacāpalam nādyāpi me mano nātha karhi syād astu śīghrataḥ

lines: Mine is the Master, yonder — father, then Three-eyed, then mother Bhavānī.
No second here, whoever, mine is. Thus most-content may I roam.
